description: Attendance is not established for the January 30 citizen-led demonstration, January 21 torch rallies, January 21 Butwal rally, or the January 20 ward-level rallies; the number of sites is not a crowd count.
required_followup: Search contemporary Nepali reporting and event-specific captions or records for attendance at each gathering; preserve qualitative wording without inventing a number.

description: Event-specific state responses, protester violence, and physical endings are not described in the opened January 22 and January 30 reports. Silence remains unknown.
required_followup: Search contemporaneous follow-up reports for actual negotiations, arrests, beatings, dispersal mechanisms, killings, shootings, protester violence, and participants physically departing.

description: The reports describe a recurring movement after the December 20 House dissolution and a factional program announced to run January 4-February 5, but do not establish that each campaign day was one continuous event.
required_followup: Check December and February event chronology and the additional Coding Procedure before treating adjacent gatherings as one event or separate observations; do not use the schedule as evidence of occurrence.

description: The January 20 Nepali Congress ward rallies may have been election-campaign activity; the source says the speeches sounded like a campaign and does not detail per-rally state demands.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous statements or local coverage identifying specific demands, event format, and any link to upcoming elections.

description: The January 14 Nepal Press, January 30 Drishti, and January 10 Prasashan sources remain search-only after extractor Cache miss errors. The January 2 Nagarik, January 9 Republica, January 25–26 Kathmandu Post, and January 30 Himalayan Times Singha Durbar reports were opened. A retrospective ACLED report and several Kathmandu Post result leads remain unopened.
required_followup: Pursue other relevant unopened primary reporting once; do not retry the three local URLs already returning Cache miss, and preserve them as unresolved leads.

description: One Nepali-language query has been run, but most surfaced Nepali-language pages remain unopened and region-specific local coverage is still thin.
required_followup: Continue Nepali-language searches by week, sector and region; translate source wording conservatively and record translation provenance.

description: Coverage is incomplete after 5 open-web searches. The current pass includes broad English, Nepali-language, and date-targeted searches, but no systematic source archive equivalent to LexisNexis or sustained week-by-week provincial and sector searches.
required_followup: Continue dated English and Nepali searches by week, region, and protest sector; document ignored date filters and inaccessible archives; do not treat empty results as absence.

description: Nepali search results surfaced a January 14 Nepal Students’ Union demonstration and multiple December/January protest leads; several have not been opened, so event date, threshold, demand and episode ownership are not yet resolved.
required_followup: Recover the January 14 article and inspect the January 10 action; use the December results to test cross-month episode boundaries without treating a campaign as one continuous gathering.

description: The attempted January 1-7 English search returned mostly late-January and February results, so its date window was ignored. It did not establish absence of early-month gatherings.
required_followup: Search exact dates and Nepali calendar dates for January 1-7 separately, then verify event occurrence dates inside the source rather than relying on result ranking.

description: ACLED reports that its supplementary Nepal collection used more than 20 local/subnational Nepali-language sources across all seven provinces; this dossier has not yet searched comparable provincial and district outlets systematically.
required_followup: Use the report’s coverage context to broaden source discovery across provinces and Nepali outlets. Do not treat ACLED’s aggregate trends as individual MM candidates.

description: ACLED cites a Reuters report dated January 22 for the dissolution demonstrations, but the linked Reuters page returned a non-retryable tool error and exposed no title or body.
required_followup: Search for the Reuters article by its topic/title and date to see whether a separate accessible archive or search-result record exposes the original title and content; do not retry the non-retryable link through the same reference.

description: Opened contemporary Kathmandu Post reports document batons, water-cannon dispersal, and conflicting injury accounts for the Jan. 25 march. Arrest evidence conflicts in scope: a police spokesperson denied arrests during the march, while NHRC’s Jan. 26 statement broadly says police used force and arrests to disperse a Jan. 25 protest without distinguishing the nearby earlier rights-defender gathering.
required_followup: Keep march-specific arrests unknown pending phase-specific evidence; preserve police and campaigner injury accounts separately; search for attendance and physical-end details; do not conflate nearby rights-defender detentions with the march.

description: SATP’s opened THT-attributed entry reports “thousands” across a national Jan. 9 action in all 330 provincial constituencies, including a mass in Budhanilkanta. This aggregate count would exceed the threshold if the nationwide program is one event, but venue-level counts and whether these are one national event or separate local events remain unresolved; the THT original was not found.
required_followup: Search for the underlying THT report and assess national-versus-local event grouping; preserve “thousands” qualitatively and do not infer attendance at each site.

description: The January 16 Nepali Congress action is reported across 753 local levels and includes a “mass” in Bharatpur, but no venue-specific attendance is given.
required_followup: Open The Himalayan Times report and look for Chitwan/local contemporary coverage of the Bharatpur gathering and attendance.

description: The January 31 Sifal civil-society protest is confirmed by a secondary listing but has no attendance count or independently opened event report.
required_followup: Find the contemporaneous Republica report cited in the listing and any local photo/report giving attendance and physical end.

description: The opened Jan. 30 Himalayan Times report confirms the Nepali Congress protest took place Friday, Jan. 29, and says police arrested protesters, but provides no crowd count or number arrested.
required_followup: Search for independent contemporary attendance and arrest details, any other event-specific response, and evidence of the physical ending; keep eligibility pending the 50-person threshold.

description: The Jan. 25 rights-defender gathering at Baluwatar is directly reported and around two dozen detentions are reported, but no total crowd size is given. Detention count does not establish whether the 50-person threshold was met.
required_followup: Find an attendance estimate or additional contemporaneous account; establish the gathering’s physical end and the detainees’ disposition without conflating it with the separate Broad Citizens Movement march.

description: The THT article result was published Jan. 16, 2021 and says a Santapur assembly occurred Saturday, but its photo caption likely has a 2020 typo. It describes “scores of attendees” without a number. The search ref and exact URL each returned Cache miss; the primary article remains unopened.
required_followup: Seek a distinct local source to verify the Jan. 16 occurrence date, attendance threshold, responses, and physical end; do not repeat the same Cache-miss opens.

description: Official NHRC January statements also surfaced a sugarcane-payment dispute and Ganga Maya Adhikari’s ongoing individual hunger strike. The January 20 statement concerns partial implementation of a Dec. 28, 2020 agreement and does not establish a new January assembly; the Jan. 21 statement dates Ganga Maya’s individual fast from Dec. 21, 2020 and does not establish a mass public gathering.
required_followup: Keep these as sector and boundary coverage checks; do not create January protest candidates or response codings without evidence of a qualifying public gathering.

description: The Jan. 6 ANNFSU lantern rally in Kathmandu and chapter whistle rallies nationwide are directly documented by Kathmandu Post; no local or national attendance estimate is given. Republica and SATP repeat related accounts but are not independent of their cited underlying reporting.
required_followup: Seek site-level attendance and any response or physical-end information; review whether the coordinated multi-site action is coded as one event or separate local events; do not infer crowd size from photos.

description: The opened Jan. 14 Republica report confirms an NSU symbolic protest in Kathmandu but gives no attendance, exact site, response, or end. A separate Nepal Press Jan. 14 search result places an NSU action at Maitighar; its relationship to the Republica report remains unresolved.
required_followup: Do not repeat the Nepal Press URL after its Cache misses. Seek an alternate copy or other contemporaneous source to establish whether the reports refer to one or two actions, and seek attendance, event response, and physical-end evidence.

description: Khabarhub announced a civil-society rally for Jan. 12, and OnlineKhabar listed a Jan. 26 whistle rally as part of a protest program. Neither search result confirms either event occurred.
required_followup: Search contemporaneous reports for actual occurrence, attendance, domestic state demand, response, and physical ending before creating candidate events.

description: Opened SATP’s Nepal timeline attributes a Jan. 10 Maitighar-to-Baneshwor bullock-cart protest and police clash to Republica. A separate Prasashan lead (E007) describes Dahal-Nepal student-wing bullock-cart demonstrations across several locations on the same date. These may describe the same program; crowd size and exact police mechanism remain unknown.
required_followup: Find or open the underlying Republica report and compare it with the Prasashan multi-location lead. Establish whether E017 is the Kathmandu component of E007, and seek attendance, exact police action, and physical end before merging/separating.

description: SATP’s opened timeline reports an RPP-led Jan. 11 march at Singha Durbar demanding monarchy restoration and a clash after police tried to stop or redirect participants, but no attendance count is provided.
required_followup: Find the underlying THT article; seek attendance and exact police action, then determine whether the march met the 50-person threshold and when it physically ended.
